_comment: Config for register-lifecycle-subscriptions.mjs. Fill webhookBaseUrl with telemetry-dashboard's stable Live URL (mapps code:status liveUrl, no trailing slash). Fill each appSlug and featureSlug from the monday Developer Center: open the app -> the feature -> copy the URL slug. Apps with an empty featureSlug are skipped with a warning.

apps.name: axis-day-off
apps._comment: appSlug + featureSlug: Developer Center -> app -> feature URL slug. liveVersionId discovered via app-version:list (v3, status live). draftVersionId is v4 (status draft).

apps.name: axis-sync-calender
apps._comment: appSlug + featureSlug: Developer Center -> app -> feature URL slug. No live version exists yet (app has only v1 draft) — liveVersionId/featureId were discovered against that draft as the fallback.

apps.name: axis-tracker
apps._comment: appSlug + featureSlug: Developer Center -> app -> feature URL slug. liveVersionId discovered via app-version:list (v24, status live). App also has an AppFeatureObject feature (id 19856477) not tracked here — out of scope. draftVersionId is v25 (status draft); its AppFeatureBoardView draft feature id is 23902079 (draft also has an AppFeatureObject id 23902080, out of scope to match live).

apps.name: axis-planner
apps._comment: appSlug + featureSlug: Developer Center -> app -> feature URL slug. liveVersionId discovered via app-version:list (v15, status live). kind corrected: the live version's only feature is actually AppFeatureObject, not AppFeatureBoardView as originally assumed. draftVersionId is v16 (status draft).

apps.name: discussions
apps._comment: appSlug + featureSlug: Developer Center -> app -> feature URL slug. liveVersionId discovered via app-version:list (v8, status live). App also has an AppFeatureObject feature (id 24198897) not tracked here — out of scope. draftVersionId is v9 (status draft; app-level name shows as 'Meetings' at this version, but the feature itself is still named 'Discussions'). Draft also has an AppFeatureObject id 24201608, out of scope to match live.

apps.name: team-people-column
apps._comment: appSlug + featureSlug: Developer Center -> app -> feature URL slug. liveVersionId discovered via app-version:list (v3, status live). kind kept as AppFeatureColumn: the manifest's real feature type is the more specific 'AppFeaturePeopleColumn', but the monday AppFeatureTypeE enum has no separate people-column value (only a generic COLUMN bucket), so AppFeatureColumn is the correct lifecycle kind. The app's other feature, 'Team People Dialog' (id 24160946, AppFeatureDialog), is a supporting UI dialog, not a lifecycle-tracked surface — out of scope. draftVersionId is v4 (status draft); its 'Team People' draft feature is typed AppFeaturePeopleColumn (id 24310172) in app-features:list, consistent with the manifest. Draft also has 'Team People Dialog' AppFeatureDialog id 24310174, out of scope.

apps.name: deadline-confirm
apps._comment: No board feature — app-level webhooks only (Developer Center -> Webhooks), so features stays empty.
